Confirm/retake/stop prompt after an odometer photo is processed. Body is a single placeholder — the prompt text (reading, vehicle, confidence, or the unreadable-photo message) is fully computed and has no fixed skeleton in the spec.

__annotations.why_this_example_exists: Shows the additionalTemplates.json half of mr_save_request.json and odometer_extract_validate.json — every templateName those two tools reference that has no spec action behind it is minted here, in the exact reply shape template-generation itself uses. Keys follow the <tool_name>__<node_id> convention — distinct from template-generation's spec-driven <step_key>__<slug> keys, so the two can never collide.
__annotations.single_placeholder_note: mr_save_request__confirm_to_requestor and odometer_extract_validate__send_prompt are both body "{{TEXT}}" — nothing more. A template does not need a fixed skeleton in the spec's wording to exist; a fully computed message is still sent through send_template_message, just with the whole computed string as that one parameter.
